R/ TRANQVILLI-TAS AVG PP ; D/ HADRIANVS AVGVSTVS

A silver denarius of Hadrian, AD117-138. Mint is Rome, AD132-134, (Reece period 6). Reverse legend reads TRANQVILLI-TAS AVG PP. Reverse shows Tranquillitas standing left holding sceptre and leaning on column. See RIC II, p.365, no.223. Obverse shows laureate, draped and cuirassed bust right.
